flags.evidence: Opened page/index.html from disk at 1440x900 and 390x844 (no page errors). At 1440 the first screen holds three actions: the 'Lamplit' wordmark (href '#'), the header text link 'Testing on TestFlight' (14px, 137x17px, no fill) and the 'Keep tonight's answer' button (filled dark pill, 413x51px, inside the lit question card). The most prominent action, and so the table's primary action, is 'Keep tonight's answer'. Operated it at both widths: disabled until text is entered; after typing 'Toast.' and clicking, the card shows 'Kept. It's in your week below. Change it', the 'Tonight' row of the week list shows 'Toast.', and localStorage 'lamplit.tonight' holds the answer. The card states before the visitor acts 'This page stores your answer in this browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere.', so it does what it says. Its repeat, the week-list link 'Answer tonight's question' (href '#answer'), targets the existing textarea#answer. The flagged button 'Ask for a TestFlight invite' (a#invite-link) does have href 'mailto:invites@lamplit.app?subject=TestFlight%20invite...', an address the brief does not supply, but it is not in the first screen at 1440 (top at y=2154px) and is not the most prominent first-screen action; the header link 'Testing on TestFlight' only scrolls to the existing #invite section, which its label does not misdescribe. Under the table, a secondary link with an unsupplied address is scored under interaction or honesty, not HF1. Primary action works, so HF1 is not met.
